dorms.name: Marchionini-Stiftung
dorms.how: Post the official form, a motivation letter and 2 photos to the office at Steinickeweg 7, 80798 München
dorms.wait: A committee decides; then a waiting list (always full)
dorms.note: 84 residents near the Olympiapark, self-run with a house bar. Only students of Munich's public universities; the house expects political interest and help with running the dorm.

rooms.note: 84 hexagonal rooms of 20 m² with own bath and kitchenette; shared kitchen too

conn.alt: Some U3 trips are better to change at Giselastraße instead.

other: House leaflet: committee of residents and the head decides; accepted applicants wait on a list; first contract 12 months on trial, then 2 more years (marchionini.net)
House website: hexagonal 20 m² rooms with own bath and kitchenette, fully furnished; roof terrace, bar, kitchen and workshop (marchionini.net)

good: Great community; several call it the best dorm in Munich
Popular house bar
bad: Hexagonal rooms look striking but are hard to furnish
rev.basis: all 7 written reviews (of 24 ratings), newest 10 months ago.

dorms.name: Apian Aparthaus
dorms.how: Email info@apian-aparthaus.de or use the form on apian-aparthaus.de, with a copy of your ID, your enrolment certificate and the start date you want
dorms.when: Any time, while flats are free
dorms.rent: €830 all-in (Apian 1, ≈ 20 m²) or €950 (Apian 2, ≈ 24 m²) · incl. €230 costs
dorms.wait: No list: flats are let while any are free
dorms.note: Two private houses in Unterföhring, across the Isar from the U6 (bus 233 to Studentenstadt). Apian 1 is for students only; Apian 2 also takes nursing and social-care staff. The town owns 17 flats in Apian 2 (house B) and lets them itself for €450 + costs.

rooms.note: ≈ 20 m² (Apian 1) or ≈ 24 m² (Apian 2): kitchenette with ceramic hob and fridge, own shower bath

parts.name: Apian 1 · Apianstraße 7
parts.note: 475 flats ≈ 20 m², students only · €600 + €230 costs

parts.name: Apian 2 · Apianstraße 7a/7b
parts.note: 128 flats ≈ 24 m², built over the car park; students and social/nursing jobs · €720 + €230

parts.name: Town flats in Apian 2, house B
parts.note: 17 furnished flats of 23.7 m² for €450 + heating and costs; students, trainees, town staff and social jobs; max. 8 years; town hall allocates in rounds

other: Unterföhring town paper (Apr 2026): the town bought 17 flats in Apian 2 house B and lets them for €450 + costs; written applications to the town hall, decided by the housing committee (unterfoehring.de)
Operator website: let 'at any time, while stocks last'; furnished, kitchenette with ceramic hob and fridge, own bath with daylight; security service and video surveillance (apian-aparthaus.de)

bad: Expensive for the size: one calls it 'over €830 for a prison cell', another says about €30 per m²
Fees to leave early (€1,000 and €3,500 mentioned); deposits returned slowly and not in full
Contract says move out 3 days before it ends, which falls in Oktoberfest week
Strict quiet rules after 22:00, unfriendly staff, slow repairs; one mentions bugs
Several say the operator gets bad reviews removed, so the score may be too high
rev.basis: the 5 written reviews Google shows first (of 63 ratings); I could not page through the rest without the browser.

dorms.name: Studierendenwohnanlage Oberschleißheim
dorms.rent: €399.50–420.40 warm · room in a WG (bath shared by two €431.30–438.20; own bath €445.30)
dorms.wait: ≈ 1 semester
dorms.note: 171 places next to the regatta lake, opened 1997, first meant for vet students. S1 Oberschleißheim for Munich; bus 292 for Garching. Max. 7 semesters on a Bachelor's, 4 on a Master's. Deposit is 3× base rent.

rooms.note: Room in a flat for 3–4 · 41 places
Room in a flat for 4–12, bath shared by two · 122 places
8 places

conn.alt: Or stay on bus 292 all the way to Garching-Forschungszentrum (33 min ride).

other: STWM: Munich, Garching and Weihenstephan are each about 25 min away by public transport; communal kitchens and a common room (studierendenwerk-muenchen-oberbayern.de)
DAAD hall finder: 171 furnished places; single rooms share shower, WC and kitchen in their group (daad.de)

good: Friendly people; good for studying and for parties
Quiet and peaceful
Direct bus to the Garching campus; supermarkets, pool, post office nearby
bad: Rural, feels far from Munich at first
A bit far from the city centre

dorms.name: Wohnanlage Dietersheim (MAYRBAU)
dorms.how: Answer the ads for 'Hauptstraße 2a, Dietersheim' on immowelt or WG-Gesucht (many posted by Hans Mayr Hochbau GmbH); no central website found
dorms.rent: ≈ €660–830 cold for 18–25.5 m² (ads), plus utilities · one WG-Gesucht ad: €817 for 19 m²
dorms.wait: No list: flats are let as they come free
dorms.note: New building by Baugeschäft Mayr (MAYRBAU), finished 2025: 85 furnished flats of 20–35 m², half reserved for students. Bus 690 or X660 from the door reaches Garching-Forschungszentrum in 4–5 min.

rooms.note: 18–35 m², fully furnished: kitchenette with ceramic hob, combi microwave and fridge; shower and WC

conn.alt: You arrive straight at the campus, where the U6 starts.

other: Eching town press release (Jul 2025): 85 furnished units, 50% for student housing; common room, free laundry, cellar for each flat, about 60 underground parking spaces; KfW 40 Plus with groundwater heat pump and solar (eching.de)
Letting ads: student flats only for students; kitchenette with combi microwave, ceramic hob and fridge, shower and WC; some ground-floor flats with a terrace (immowelt.de)

bad: €200 charged for cleaning a one-room flat at move-out, without being told clearly
rev.basis: the only written review.
